title: Retain actual verification observations and provenance
description: Records what occurred in an identifiable verification assessment with its actual basis and supporting evidence. It distinguishes incomplete execution and inability to assess from both positive and negative criterion observations.
inputs: Assessment occurrence, verification definition and criterion basis, and exact subject state.
Actual conditions, observing participant or source, execution state, observed results, and supporting evidence.
preconditions: The recording identifies the assessment occurrence and can distinguish supplied observations from intended future checks.
outputs: Identifiable observed evidence with its original assessment basis and provenance.
Known unperformed, incomplete, failed-to-execute, or unavailable evidence scope.
behavior: Retain observed outcomes with their exact subject, method, criterion, conditions, occurrence, and observing source.
Record only actual observations as evidence and identify planned or unperformed checks separately.
Preserve negative or contradictory observations and distinguish failure to execute a technique from an observed failure to satisfy a criterion.
Identify inaccessible supporting evidence or missing provenance as a limitation on reliance.
Keep earlier observations attributable to their original basis when later assessments supply new results.

failure_behavior.condition: The supposed result contains only a plan, expected observation, or passing label without actual supporting observations.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the missing evidence and do not present an executed result as established.

failure_behavior.condition: An assessment was interrupted or its evidence could not be retained fully.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve known observations and disclose the unassessed or unavailable scope.

failure_behavior.condition: Observation provenance or exact assessed state is unresolved.
failure_behavior.outcome: Record the uncertainty and prevent silent reliance on an invented basis.

sources.basis: SR-026 confirms observed-evidence retention under IR-004; applicability and judgments are separate FUNC-029 and FUNC-031 responsibilities.

Propose MOD-007 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
